summary: A satirical piece on the 2023 health and wellness market, which it calls the "Health-Conomy," mocking the many fads and the self-styled gurus who sell them. It lampoons superfood, gluten-free, juice cleanse, fitness tracking, mindfulness, super-organic, and sleep products, with invented personalities and brands. It ends by predicting that new wellness marvels will keep lightening wallets.
one_line: A satirical look at the 2023 health and wellness market, mocking quinoa, gluten-free, juicing, fitness, mindfulness, organic and sleep fads and their peddlers.
key_facts: The article observes the health and wellness sector, dubbed the "Health-Conomy," as of September 1, 2023.
John Everyman, CEO of Superfoods Inc., claims his trademarked Quinoa™ will help you find your third eye.
The "kale kleptocracy," led by Scarlett Spinach, tries to convince shoppers that eating kale gives superhero powers.
Wendy Wheatless, founder of Gluten-Not, says she won't rest until the air is devoid of gluten and sells a gluten-free air purifier.
Gluten-free labels are mocked as appearing on products that never contained gluten, such as water and shampoo.
Dr. Citrus Von Squeezeworth's "Purge the Urge to Splurge" juice cleanse involves ingesting nothing but murky green potions for a fortnight.
Madam Berry BeetBoost, his rival, sells a red concoction that she claims awakens your ancestral plant-based spirit, priced at $12 a bottle of mashed beets.
Freddie Fitbit and his cronies are portrayed as convincing the public that exercise doesn't count unless every step is tracked.
Helga Hyperthrust leads the CrossFit cult and swears by flipping tires as a path to enlightenment.
Sir Meditatus Alot sells meditation mats, sold alongside Spotify playlists of whale cries and didgeridoo deep drops, for four easy payments of $19.99.
Olga Organic promotes "super-organic" food, such as carrots serenaded by Mozart sonatas, at a premium price.
The Sandman Syndicate, led by Mr. Snoozemaster, sells climate-controlled pillowcases and mattresses that rock you into REM sleep, promising an end to insomnia and to financial stability.
